cards.card_text: Last comes the rest in purest gold: flowers, lamps, tongs, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, censers, and the gold doors to the Most Holy Place and the main hall.
cards.verse_text: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold; the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place as well as the doors of the main hall.
cards.snippet: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold; the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers…

cards.card_text: He took it with tongs, and friend, I respect ANYBODY who reaches for the tongs.
cards.verse_text: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
cards.snippet: …in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
